text: AnyAudio 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的音频制作插件，通过注册五个音频工具、提示词和设置页面，把音乐、音效、语音生成与混音接入 Agent 工作流。它可将基于音符的乐谱渲染为 SoundFont 乐器 WAV，生成时间轴音效与旁白，把多轨音频混合并进行旁白闪避，还能管理音源。适合制作视频配乐、场景音效、有声内容和独立音乐；使用 MiMo 语音引擎需要配置 MIMO_API_KEY，Edge TTS 不需要密钥，部分功能需要 ffmpeg。

AnyAudio is a DSH web plugin with tools for SoundFont music rendering, timeline sound effects, text to speech, multitrack mixing, and sound bank management. It supports video and spoken content workflows. MiMo TTS needs MIMO_API_KEY; Edge TTS does not. Some features need ffmpeg.
想让 Agent 用真实乐器音色给视频配乐。
能不能把音符乐谱直接渲染成 WAV？
我需要给动画添加雨声、脚步声这类时间轴音效。
想把文字变成旁白音频，最好能选语音和风格。
怎么把旁白、音乐和音效混成一条视频音轨？
I need an agent to score a video with sampled instruments.
Can I generate narration and mix it with effects on a timeline?
Help me install and choose SoundFont banks for generated music.
AnyAudio 的功能「music」：把基于秒数和音符的乐谱渲染成多轨乐器 WAV，可设置乐器、音源、增益、声像和混响。 通过对应音频工具触发，输入乐谱、文字、音效参数或音轨，输出音频文件。
AnyAudio 的功能「sfx」：在时间轴上生成预设或程序化音效，并输出 WAV，适合为场景添加雨声、脚步等声音。 通过对应音频工具触发，输入乐谱、文字、音效参数或音轨，输出音频文件。
AnyAudio 的功能「tts」：将一段或多段文字合成为旁白 WAV，可选择 Edge 或 MiMo 引擎、声音和风格。 通过对应音频工具触发，输入乐谱、文字、音效参数或音轨，输出音频文件。
AnyAudio 的功能「mix」：把旁白、音乐和音效按时间轴混合，支持增益、淡入淡出、循环、旁白闪避及可选视频封装。 通过对应音频工具触发，输入乐谱、文字、音效参数或音轨，输出音频文件。
AnyAudio 的功能「sources」：查看、安装和切换 SoundFont 音源，并浏览乐器与音源预设。 通过对应音频工具触发，输入乐谱、文字、音效参数或音轨，输出音频文件。
AnyAudio 使用 MiMo-V2.5-TTS 时需要 MIMO_API_KEY；默认 Edge TTS 不需要该密钥。

dsh-any-audio README · Introduction：AnyAudio is an audio production toolkit for AI agents. It turns a sound idea into an actual audio project: write notes and render real instruments, write lines and generate speech, drop in sound effects, arrange the structure, and mix the multitrack result. Video soundtracks are just one use — scenes, sound design, standalone music, audiobooks, podcasts and game audio all come out of the same pipeline.
dsh-any-audio README · Introduction：The agent keeps the creative decisions. AnyAudio supplies the tools and execution needed to turn a sound idea into a finished audio file.
dsh-any-audio README · What it solves：Models can already write code that makes sound, but it rarely sounds like an instrument, a recording, or a finished mix. AnyAudio fills that gap:

dsh-any-audio README · What it solves：- **Real instrument timbres** — rendered from local sample banks instead of hand-written oscillators.
- **Notes land directly on the timeline** — millisecond accuracy; music, narration and effects share one clock.
- **Automatic mix balance** — tracks are placed in order with per-track gain, pan and fades; declaring a track as `narration` makes the plugin duck the other buses under the voice, and the master is peak-normalised so the whole mix does not clip.
- **Effects and voices** — sound effects either sampled from the installed banks or generated procedurally, plus speech through Edge TTS and MiMo-V2.5-TTS (currently free).

dsh-any-audio README · Hear the difference：Both pairs contain identical material: one version made without the plugin, one with it. Listen first, read the numbers after.

Version A was produced the way an agent works without AnyAudio, writing NumPy synthesis directly; version B was rendered by AnyAudio from local sample banks. Same arrangement, only the sound source changed.

dsh-any-audio README · Install：Node.js 22.19+ (22.x) or 24+ (bundled with DSH); ffmpeg is only needed for speech and for muxing video.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-any-audio
```

If DSH boots a different profile, replace `desktop` with that profile name. Restart DSH once after installing so it picks up the plugin.

dsh-any-audio README · Install：Then open the **AnyAudio** page in DSH Settings to install a sound source (GeneralUser GS is the default suggestion), switch the speech engine and adjust mixing defaults. No SoundFont is bundled with the package.

dsh-any-audio README · From source：For local development, install from a clone instead of the registry:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/cloudoyx/any-audio.git
cd any-audio
npm install && npm run font
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "<absolute path to the cloned folder>"

dsh-any-audio README · From source：The path must be absolute (on Windows, `D:/any-audio` style), and DSH needs a restart once after adding it. `npm run font` downloads both suggested banks (about 72 MB) into the shared sound library, which is handy when you want the banks ready before opening Settings.

A clone also gives you the headless renderer, useful for iterating on a score without an agent:

```bash
node scripts/anyaudio-cli.mjs render score.json out.wav
```

dsh-any-audio README · Quick start：Describe the work as usual while generating a video; the agent calls the plugin to render audio on its own:

> Make a 30-second ink-wash animation: a seed in a rock crevice grows into a sapling. Add a little Chinese-style music and wind, no narration.

You can adjust musical detail and mixing behaviour as you go:

> Guzheng lead, strings bed, cello on the low end; pull the music down whenever a voice comes in.

For a song, state the brief and call it directly:

dsh-any-audio README · Quick start：> Write me a Japanese RPG battle theme, loopable, 30 to 60 seconds. Drums, electric guitar and strings.

You can even build an audiobook from scratch:

> Turn Chapter 1 of Romance of the Three Kingdoms into an audiobook — deep, rich narration, distinguishable character voices, with simple background music and effects.

dsh-any-audio README · Sound sources：The repository does not bundle SoundFonts. The plugin offers two **suggested** banks — GeneralUser GS as the default foundation and MuseScore General as an extra general-purpose orchestral bank — and it can also load compatible SoundFont files (`.sf2`, `.sf3`, `.dls`) placed in `~/.dsh/anyaudio/fonts`. That directory is one shared library for every project and agent session on the machine, so a bank installed once is available everywhere.

dsh-any-audio README · Sound sources：| Bank | Size | License | How to get it | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GeneralUser GS | 32 MB | GeneralUser GS License v2.0 | One click | **Suggested — default foundation and fallback**; the only bank guaranteed to include a drum kit |
| MuseScore General | 40 MB | MIT | One click | **Suggested — extra general-purpose orchestral bank**; 309 presets, fuller strings and ensembles |
| Upright Piano KW | 27 MB (7z) | CC0 1.0 | Manual | Single-instrument piano bank, used on piano tracks only |
| Electric Guitar Clean | 446 MB (unpacked) | CC0 1.0 | Manual | Single-instrument electric guitar bank |

dsh-any-audio README · Sound sources：Installing both suggested banks gives the widest coverage: GeneralUser GS stays the default, while MuseScore General joins the automatic ranking for orchestral families. Download links and extraction notes for the last two are in Settings and in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/cloudoyx/any-audio/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md); keep the file names unchanged after extracting so the plugin can recognise them.

dsh-any-audio README · Speech TTS：Two engines, one interface:

| Engine | Key | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Edge TTS** (default) | Not required | Free, through Microsoft's public endpoint; needs ffmpeg to convert MP3 to WAV; may be rate-limited, in which case the plugin retries and reports a clear error. |
| **MiMo-V2.5-TTS** (optional) | Normal Open Platform API key | More voices and styles; the key is stored in DSH credentials and only read on the host side. Currently free; register your own API key. |

dsh-any-audio README · Speech TTS：MiMo is opt-in: saving a key does not switch the default engine, you choose it explicitly. The default voice `mimo_default` is resolved by the service cluster and may differ between regions. This version supports normal Open Platform keys only.

dsh-any-audio README · Known limitations：- **SoundFont only** — no SFZ, Kontakt or VST; converting other source formats is out of scope for this version.
- **No per-note envelope control** — attack and release come from the preset; use short notes with gaps for staccato and velocity plus expression for dynamics.
- **Chinese instruments are GM approximations** — `guzheng` maps to Koto, `dizi` to Flute, `erhu` to Fiddle; dedicated banks will do better.

dsh-any-audio README · Support the project：AnyAudio is an independent open-source project. If it helps your work or your creation, you are welcome to buy me a coffee to support further development. Any amount is appreciated.

SoundFonts and third-party components keep their own licenses, see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/cloudoyx/any-audio/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). This repository distributes no sample banks.

dsh-any-audio README · AnyAudio：AnyAudio 是面向 AI Agent 的音频制作工具。它把"声音创意"翻译成可执行的音频工程：写音符并渲染真实乐器、写台词并生成高质量语音、注入音效并编排结构、完成多轨混音。视频配乐、场景音效、独立音乐、有声书、播客、游戏音效，全部都可以用它做出来。

Agent 负责创意与编排，AnyAudio 提供将声音创意转化为实际音频作品所需的工具与执行能力。

dsh-any-audio README · 它解决什么问题：模型已经能写代码合成声音，但很难让它听起来像乐器、像录音、像成品。AnyAudio 补的是这一段：

- **真实乐器音色**：用本地音源采样渲染，而不是手写振荡器。
- **音符直接落在时间轴上**：精确到毫秒，音乐、旁白、音效共用同一个时钟。
- **混音自动平衡**：按顺序放置多轨，支持每轨增益、声像与淡入淡出；把某轨标为 `narration` 时，插件会在人声出现时自动下压其它总线；母带做峰值归一，整体不会削波。
- **音效与配音**：音效既可取自已安装音源的采样，也可程序化合成；语音支持 Edge TTS 与 MiMo-V2.5-TTS（官方免费中）。

dsh-any-audio README · 安装：需要 Node.js 22.19+（22.x）或 24+（DSH 运行时自带）；ffmpeg 只在生成语音和封装视频时需要。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-any-audio
```

如果 DSH 启动的不是 `desktop` profile，把 `desktop` 换成实际使用的 profile 名。装完重启一次 DSH，它才会加载这个插件。

之后在 DSH 设置里打开 **AnyAudio** 页面，安装音源（默认推荐 GeneralUser GS）、切换语音引擎、调整混音默认值。安装包本身不带任何 SoundFont。

dsh-any-audio README · 从源码安装：本地开发时用克隆仓库的方式，而不是从 npm 安装：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/cloudoyx/any-audio.git
cd any-audio
npm install && npm run font
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "<克隆目录的绝对路径>"

路径要写绝对路径（Windows 上形如 `D:/any-audio`），添加后同样要重启一次 DSH。`npm run font` 会把两套建议音源（约 72 MB）下载进共享音源库，适合想在打开设置页之前就把音源准备好的情况。

克隆下来的仓库还带一个免 DSH 的离线渲染器，适合先单独把谱子调好：

```bash
node scripts/anyaudio-cli.mjs render score.json out.wav
```

dsh-any-audio README · 快速开始：生成视频时像平时一样提需求，Agent 会自己调用插件进行音频渲染：

> 做一个 30 秒的水墨动画：石缝里的一粒种子长成树苗。配一点中国风音乐和风声，不要旁白。

可以随着调整音乐细节和混音逻辑：

> 古筝主旋律，弦乐铺底，大提琴走低音；人声出现时把音乐压下去。

想写歌时说清楚需求，直接调用：

> 帮我写一首日式 RPG 的战斗曲目，可无限循环，30 秒到 60 秒。乐器用鼓组 + 电吉他 + 弦乐。

你甚至可以从零开始制作有声小说：

> 帮我把《三国演义》第一章做成有声小说，旁白低沉浑厚，角色音色要有所区分，配一些简单的配乐和音效即可。

dsh-any-audio README · 音源：仓库不打包 SoundFont。插件提供两套**建议安装**的音源——GeneralUser GS 作为默认基础音源，MuseScore General 作为额外的通用管弦乐音源——也支持加载放入 `~/.dsh/anyaudio/fonts` 的兼容 SoundFont 音源（`.sf2`、`.sf3`、`.dls`）。该目录是整台机器共用的音源库，所有项目与 Agent 会话共用同一份，装过一次即可处处可用。

dsh-any-audio README · 音源：| 音源 | 体积 | 许可证 | 获取方式 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GeneralUser GS | 32 MB | GeneralUser GS License v2.0 | 一键 | **建议安装 — 默认基础音源与兜底**；唯一保证带鼓组的音源 |
| MuseScore General | 40 MB | MIT | 一键 | **建议安装 — 额外的通用管弦乐音源**；309 个预设，弦乐与合奏更完整 |
| Upright Piano KW | 27 MB（7z） | CC0 1.0 | 手动 | 单乐器钢琴库，只用于钢琴轨 |
| Electric Guitar Clean | 446 MB（解压后） | CC0 1.0 | 手动 | 单乐器电吉他库 |

dsh-any-audio README · 音源：两套都装覆盖最广：GeneralUser GS 仍是默认音源，MuseScore General 参与管弦乐族的自动选择。后两套的下载地址与解压说明在设置页和 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/cloudoyx/any-audio/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)；解压后保持文件名不变，插件才能识别。

dsh-any-audio README · 语音 TTS：两个引擎，一个接口：

| 引擎 | Key | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Edge TTS**（默认） | 不需要 | 免费，走 Microsoft 公共接口；需要 ffmpeg 把 MP3 转成 WAV；可能被限流，插件会重试并给出明确错误。 |
| **MiMo-V2.5-TTS**（可选） | 普通 Open Platform API Key | 音色与风格更多；Key 存在 DSH 凭据里，只在宿主侧读取。官方免费中，可自行注册 API Key。 |

MiMo 是手动选项：保存 Key 不会自动切换默认引擎，要显式选择。默认音色 `mimo_default` 由服务端集群决定，不同区域可能不同。本版本只支持普通 Open Platform Key。

dsh-any-audio README · 已知限制：- **只支持 SoundFont**：不支持 SFZ、Kontakt、VST；转换其它音源格式不在本版范围。
- **没有逐音符包络控制**：发音与释放由预设决定；断奏用短音符加缝隙，强弱用力度与表情控制。
- **中国乐器是 GM 近似**：`guzheng` 映射 Koto、`dizi` 映射 Flute、`erhu` 映射 Fiddle；专用音源会更好。
